note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 148, Supreme Court Internal Guidelines 46; A06b Const 148, Supreme Court Internal Guidelines 46; L05 Const 150): ordinary naturalisation after 3 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Paraguay, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Paraguay for at least 3 years. ... n.a. ... Person is a citizen by naturalisation and voluntarily acquires another citizenship.
